title: Sponsors
description: Archived sponsorship prospectus, agreement and participation information for the San Diego 2012 OpenStack Summit. Availability and deadlines are historical.
body:
Sponsoring The OpenStack Summit

  • Sponsorship Prospectus (PDF File)
  • Sponsorship Agreement (PDF File)

Having a presence at the OpenStack Conference is a great way to get your company in front of the OpenStack community. This time, there are four available levels of Sponsorship: Headline, Permiere, Event, and Startup.

Whichever level you choose to participate, you'll want to act quicklywe've already seen a lot of interest from potential sponsors.

Read over all the details for this event in the Sponsor Prospectus. Sponsorships are limited, and will be sold on a first come, first served basis as determined by the timing of signed agreements received by sponsors@openstack.org.

To accomodate our production schedule, the deadline to become a sponsor is September 14.

Sponsorships Currently Available

  • Headline Sponsorship Package: 3 total // Sold Out
  • Premier Sponsorship Package: 6 total // 2 left
  • Event Sponsorship Package: 8 total // Sold Out
  • Startup Sponsorship Package: 8 total // Sold Out
  • We do have other options available for smaller packages without a booth, please contact sponsors@openstack.org.

Evening Event Slots Currently Available

  • Monday: 6 - 8 pm // 8 pm - late
  • Tuesday: 6 - 8 pm // 8 pm - late
  • Wednesday: 6 - 8 pm // 8 pm - late
  • Thursday: Closing Party
